lines.t: [Title: Whole Life / Glad Together]
[Atmospheric alternative R&B, luminous guitar-pop, deep warm bass]
[Two distinct male voices]
[Servant: intimate breathy tenor, dry close microphone]
[YahuShua, dramatized role: warm resonant bass-baritone, clear diction, spacious harmonies]
[Never blend the two lead voices]
[Do not sing bracketed directions]
[Intro - shimmering guitar, Rhodes, distant organ]
[Eight instrumental bars]
I brought a song into the silence,
But there's a life behind these words.
The hands I raise beneath these lights—
Will they still serve when I'm unheard?
I bring the mind that runs in circles,
The heart that wants and fears so much.
YahuShua, take this scattered offering.
Teach every part of me to love.
[Voice change - bass-baritone, spacious and tender]
Bring more than what the room can hear.
Let mercy shape the life you live.
Let truth direct the strength you carry.
Make room for someone else to sit.
When you have power, use it gently.
When you have plenty, learn to share.
Let worship reach beyond the singing,
Into the burdens you can bear.
[Instrumental transition - deep sub, rounded kick, dry rimshot]
Whole heart, whole mind,
Every breath and all my strength.
Not just a moment in the music—
Let my living speak Your praise.
These hands, this life,
All the days I haven't lived.
YahuShua, I believe You.
Let my choices answer it.
Let my choices answer it.
[Instrumental response - expressive guitar, warm rolling bass]
[Voice change - bass-baritone, steady melodic verse]
Do not mistake the place of honor
For closeness to the heart of love.
There is a neighbor needing patience.
There is a mouth that needs enough.
Let knowledge make you more attentive,
Not quick to silence someone small.
Let strength become a place of shelter,
Not something others fear at all.
Care for the body in your keeping.
Do not make beauty into pride.
There is a time to lift the burden,
And there is rest to take beside.
I have confused a strong emotion
With something deeper taking root.
I've sung surrender in the evening,
Then kept the morning back from You.
So let me listen without planning
The next impressive thing to say.
Let me believe enough to follow
Through an ordinary day.
Not to buy the love You've given.
Not to put You in my debt.
But because I trust Your mercy,
Let me take another step.
Whole heart, whole mind,
Every breath and all my strength.
Not just a moment in the music—
Let my living speak Your praise.
These hands, this life,
All the days I haven't lived.
YahuShua, I believe You.
Let my choices answer it.
And when I fall,
Don't let me call the darkness home.
Let me confess,
Make right the wrong,
And turn toward You instead of stone.
I cannot heal myself by hiding.
I cannot earn what You have given.
But I can rise and face the morning,
Trusting mercy more than shame.
[Voice change - bass-baritone, intimate and reassuring]
Do not make failure your devotion.
Do not keep kneeling to regret.
Turn from the wrong and walk in mercy.
There is a faithful step ahead.
Let sorrow lead you into turning.
Let gratitude become your song.
Bring willing hands into the morning.
Let patient love keep growing strong.
[Instrumental ascent - radiant guitars, deep bass, widening organ]
[Eight bars, no vocal ad-libs]
Whole heart, whole mind,
Every breath and all my strength.
Not just a moment in the music—
Let my living speak Your praise.
These hands, this life,
All the days I haven't lived.
YahuShua, I believe You.
Let my choices answer it.
When I give without announcing,
When I hear another's grief,
When I choose the truth in secret,
Let my faith be more than speech.
[Voice change - bass-baritone, gentle closing invitation]
Let gladness walk beside your service.
Let kindness reach beyond this room.
Let love become the way you carry
The strength entrusted unto you.
[Instrumental pause - guitar and organ only]
Then here I am.
Not just my voice.
My body.
My attention.
My affection.
My choice.
YahuShua—
A whole life,
Learning how to worship You.
[Outro - warm sustained chord, fading guitar]
[No additional words]
